# Flows: Notification
Flows: 5

FLOW Microflow: Notification.ACT_Notification_MarkAsRead
NODES=4; EDGES=2
1. START
2. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Notification (isRead=true; refreshInClient=true)
3. END

FLOW Microflow: Notification.SE_Notification_SendToInspectors
NODES=6; EDGES=5
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve TaskList from Inspection.Task
3. ACTION CreateListAction: CreateListAction (output=NotificationList_ToCommit, entity=Notification.Notification, errorHandlingType=Rollback)
4. LOOP iterate TaskList as IteratorTask
  5. LOOP BODY
    6. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Notification.Notification as NewNotification (Title='Task: ' + $IteratorTask/Title + ' is due today.', Notification_Account=$Account_Inspector, AssociatedObject=$IteratorTask/TaskID)
    7. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Inspector over association Task_Inspector from IteratorTask
    8. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.SUB_Account_GetFromInspector -> Account_Inspector
    9. ACTION ChangeListAction: change NotificationList_ToCommit (type=Add, value=$NewNotification)
10. ACTION CommitAction: commit NotificationList_ToCommit (refreshInClient=false, withEvents=true)
11. END

FLOW Microflow: Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToInspector
NODES=7; EDGES=5
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Inspector over association Task_Inspector from Task
3. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.SUB_Account_GetFromInspector -> Account_Inspector
4. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Account_Assigner from Administration.Account
5. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Notification.Notification as NewNotification (Title='An inspection task has been assigned to you on ' + formatDateTime([%CurrentDateTime%], 'dd/MM/yyyy'), Notification_Account=$Account_Inspector, AssociatedObject=$Task/TaskID, Message=$Account_Assigner/FullName + ' has assigned a task to you.')
6. END

FLOW Microflow: Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToManager
NODES=7; EDGES=5
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Inspector over association Task_Inspector from Task
3. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Account_Inspector over association Inspector_Account from Inspector
4. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Account_Assigner from Administration.Account
5. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Notification.Notification as NewNotification (Title='An inspection task has been completed on ' + formatDateTime([%CurrentDateTime%], 'dd/MM/yyyy'), Notification_Account=$Account_Assigner, AssociatedObject=$Task/TaskID, Message=$Account_Inspector/FullName + ' has completed a task.')
6. END

FLOW Microflow: Notification.TEMP_Notifications_AllDelete
NODES=5; EDGES=4
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve NotificationList from Notification.Notification
3. ACTION DeleteAction: delete NotificationList (refreshInClient=false)
4. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=All notifications deleted., type=Information, blocking=true)
5. END

## Outgoing Calls
- Notification.SE_Notification_SendToInspectors -> Inspection.SUB_Account_GetFromInspector (Microflow, internal)
- Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToInspector -> Inspection.SUB_Account_GetFromInspector (Microflow, internal)
